definitions.explanation: The activity or act of swimming. The noun form of 泳ぐ.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{泳|およ}ぎが{上手|じょうず}だ。
{夏|なつ}は{海|うみ}で{泳|およ}ぎを{楽|たの}しむ。
examples.english: I enjoy swimming in the sea in summer.

notes:
{泳|およ}ぎ is the noun form of {泳|およ}ぐ (to swim).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {泳|およ}ぎが{上手|じょうず}/{下手|へた} (good/bad at swimming)
- {泳|およ}ぎを{楽|たの}しむ (to enjoy swimming)
- 〜の{泳|およ}ぎ (~ style of swimming)

SWIMMING STYLES:
- {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ (breaststroke)
- {背泳|せおよ}ぎ (backstroke)
- {犬|いぬ}かき (doggy paddle)
- クロール (freestyle/front crawl)
- バタフライ (butterfly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {泳|およ}ぎ: swimming (as activity or skill)
- {水泳|すいえい}: swimming (sport, formal)
